newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso calm after C. Bank rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso calm after C. Bank rate hike.

text.p: The Philippine peso was calm in early trade on Thursday after the Central Bank further raised it key overnight borrowing rate by two percentage points to 32 percent, traders said.
The peso traded from 26.40/26.398 from the previous close of 26.40 pesos. Volume was at $111 million in more than an hour of trade.
"The market was calm," a trader said.
But another trader said banks were still buying dollars despite the high overnight rate.
"They're probably covering their short dollar positions. Though it's good to be short," the dealer said.
Traders said the Central Bank was not intervening in the market but it indicated its willingness to sell at 26.40 pesos.
The Central Bank has raised its key rate four times in more than a week after Wednesday's renewed devaluation scare. The Monetary Board denied there was such a move.
